column1: # Existing compatibility gaps, temporarily skipped with the user's approval (2026-11-12).
# probe glob<TAB>tracking issue<TAB>reason. Probes still execute and keep artifacts.
# Only completed, nonempty, exit-0 results can be quarantined, and only the difference lines
# quarantine.json accepts (a SHA-256 per line; an image line hashes both whole images). A
# fixed line may disappear; a new or changed line fails. A probe glob alone allows nothing.
# compare.py prints the failing quarantined probes' line hashes as "quarantine candidates"
# (and --quarantine-observed FILE writes them): CI never approves or updates them itself.
